flags.why: This means a date fixed in advance, rather than any particular day ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/nhat-ki-eH90l4cZfSW7T.html)).
flags.fix: appointed date; a day fixed in advance

flags.why: This expression is characteristic of Southern Vietnamese and needs a regional label ([source](https://khcn.tdmu.edu.vn/Data/files/1_%20Ky%20yeu%20Hoc%20vien%281%29.pdf)).
This is a children's teasing exclamation when displaying food to tempt another child, not an adjective meaning grimy ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/nhẻm_nhèm_nhem)).
flags.fix: an exclamation children use to tease another child by showing food they have

flags.why: The example incorrectly uses a teasing exclamation as an adjective describing a dirty face ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/nhẻm_nhèm_nhem)).
flags.fix: Nó giơ cái bánh lên trêu bạn: "Nhẻm nhèm nhem!" = He held up the cake to tease his friend: "Look what I've got!"
